text: Mayday, mayday, mayday. Control, northwest 808. Emergency descent. Do rapid depressurization. Now, 8,400 meters descending to 4,200 meters. Request priority landing at your field. Northwest, 808. Wuhan control. Roger the mayday. Descend to 3,900 meters. Descend to 3,900 meters, northwest 808. All stations, emergency descent in progress from 8,400 meters over Hotel Zulu. All aircraft below 8,100 meters in the vicinity of Hotel Zulu leave this area to the east immediately and contact 123.15. Question. Which aircraft will change the frequencies?
